research.title: Evidence Conflict Detection for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Formulated whether disagreement among retrieved passages predicts unsupported answers, and developed an entailment-based scoring method for evidence conflict.
Led development of conflict-aware passage selection and evaluated answer support through retrieval ablations and manual analysis of contradictory evidence.

research.title: Negation-Sensitive Representations for Paraphrase Detection
bullets: Investigated whether contrastive training with negation edits reduces false paraphrase matches, and developed a training objective separating semantic similarity from equivalence.
Constructed controlled sentence transformations and evaluated the method against standard contrastive baselines, inspecting errors involving scope, antonymy, and lexical overlap.

research.title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in Task-Oriented Dialogue
bullets: Formulated when dialogue systems should request clarification rather than commit to an intent, and developed a policy combining intent uncertainty with slot ambiguity.
Led policy development using calibrated intent predictions, comparing clarification decisions with confidence thresholds and analyzing ambiguous utterances across dialogue contexts.

research.title: Selective Text Classification Under Domain Shift
bullets: Formulated how domain shift affects classifier abstention, and led development of confidence scoring that combines predictive uncertainty with representation-based domain similarity.
Designed cross-domain evaluations of calibration and selective risk, with ablations examining class imbalance, rejection thresholds, and interpretable summaries of abstained documents.

work.title: Document Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for document import requests, handling missing fields, malformed text encodings, and duplicate records within existing service interfaces.
Added regression tests for import failures and investigated reported defects using application logs, documenting reproduction steps and verifying fixes.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented lexical retrieval and sentence embedding retrieval over a shared document collection, using consistent preprocessing and relevance judgments for comparison.
Compared ranking quality and query latency, examining retrieval failures involving rare terminology, paraphrased queries, and documents with overlapping vocabulary.

projects.title: Sequence Tagging for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field baseline and a transformer token classifier, aligning tokenization and label conventions across both approaches.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, analyzing boundary errors, unseen entity mentions, and sensitivity to the amount of labeled training data.

projects.title: Extractive and Generative Dialogue Summarization
bullets: Implemented sentence-ranking extraction and fine-tuned an encoder-decoder summarizer on dialogue transcripts, applying shared data splits and text normalization procedures.
Compared lexical overlap metrics with manual checks of factual consistency, speaker attribution, and coverage of decisions expressed across multiple turns.

projects.title: Dependency Parsing with Transition-Based and Graph-Based Models
bullets: Implemented transition-based and graph-based dependency parsers using shared token representations, following established parsing algorithms and matched training data preparation.
Compared attachment accuracy and decoding cost, categorizing errors by dependency length, sentence structure, and ambiguous attachment of prepositional phrases.
